title: Pause chip x-position has no clamp for window widths below 1220 — overlaps the forecast weather panel
evidence: app/main.odin:260: `chip := rl.Rectangle{f32(app.view.win_w/2 + 240), 12, 120, 38}` (right edge = win_w/2 + 360). app/render/forecast.odin:62: `x := v.win_w - card_w - pad` with card_w=230, pad=10 and draw_panel_card at x-pad → weather card left edge = win_w - 250. app/main.odin:205-206: `if rl.IsWindowResized() {` / `rnd.view_compute(&app.view, rl.GetScreenWidth(), rl.GetScreenHeight(), &cat.balance)`
detail: Chip right edge win_w/2+360 exceeds forecast left edge win_w−250 whenever win_w < 1220 — a mid-crisis pause then puts the chip over the weather report. No min-width guard; the resize handler treats win_w as variable (popover.odin: 'the app is resizable').
recommended_fix: Clamp the chip, e.g. chip.x = min(win_w/2 + 240, win_w - 250 - 120 - 4), or hide/displace it when the gap collapses; state the constraint next to the geometry comment.

title: Opaque pause chip draws after the paused-live demolish popover and can cover its demolish button
evidence: app/main.odin:240: `rnd.draw_demolish_popover(&app.view, &app.state.topology, &app.cat, app.sel_node, app.sel_pipe)` (drawn first). app/main.odin:261: `rl.DrawRectangleRec(chip, rl.Color{238, 230, 210, 255})` (opaque, drawn after). app/render/popover.odin:48-50: `if y + h > f32(v.win_h) { y = f32(v.win_h) - h - 8 }` / `if y < 8 { y = 8 }` — only bottom/tray clamps; POPOVER_H_PIPE = 64, demolish_button_rect = pop.y + h − 36.
detail: A selected pipe clamped to the top edge (pop.y=8) puts its demolish button at rows 36–62; the opaque chip band (x 880–1000, y 12–50) covers rows 36–50 while paused. popover_rect has no top-band exclusion (it has one for the tray). Hit-testing is unaffected — visual occlusion only.
recommended_fix: Exclude the chip band in popover_rect (mirroring the TRAY_CLEAR bottom clamp), or move the chip draw before the demolish popover so the popover stays on top while paused.
